recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, desaturated black-and-white portrait of a woman with dark hair and a blonde streak, wearing a white tank top and suspenders. The subject is positioned off-center against a neutral, slightly textured studio background, with vintage typewriter-style text placed in the upper-left negative space.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark hair and suspenders contrast sharply against the light skin and white tank top.
The typewriter text balances the visual weight of the subject's leaning pose.
The tattoos on the subject's arms provide a fine-line texture that complements the gritty typography.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic color palette with a slight warm or cool tint.
Typewriter-style typography with ink-bleed or stamp-like imperfections.
Subject with visible tattoos and a specific 'indie' fashion style (suspenders, tank top).

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is medium-shot, positioned on the right two-thirds of the frame, leaning slightly toward the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the high-contrast dark hair/blonde streak.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the face, move down the arm with tattoos, and finish at the text in the upper-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open space on the left side of the frame to accommodate typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-gray background providing a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the hair, suspenders, and text for definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright whites in the tank top and hair streak for highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value range from pure white highlights to deep black shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Rough, irregular edges simulating physical ink on paper
characterSpecificRedesigns: Lower-case 'l' and 't' have distinct typewriter-style crossbars and tails
Periods are heavy and slightly irregular
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family variation using different weights or sizes of the same typewriter face.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the distressed typewriter look with modern legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a monochromatic studio portrait of a woman with dark hair and a blonde streak, wearing a white tank top and black suspenders, leaning against a plain gray wall. Ensure visible fine-line tattoos on her arms.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of lowercase typewriter-style text in the upper left corner using a black ink-bleed effect.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the upper-left corner lowercase?
Does the subject have the characteristic blonde hair streak?

adjustableVariables: Placement of the text (left vs right negative space)
mustRedesign: Specific tattoo designs to avoid copyright
Exact facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Verify the presence of the blonde hair streak
Ensure the suspenders are clearly defined against the tank top
Confirm the text is entirely lowercase
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Studio Portrait + Off-Center Composition + Distressed Typewriter Typography in Negative Space.
